calculation.description: Fades each asset's 60-day return relative to the cross-sectional median and scales the contrarian deviation by trailing annualized realized volatility. Signal is lagged one completed session to avoid look-ahead bias.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across all evaluated non-empty regimes: 2024-2026 IC 0.388177 (92 dates), 2027-2029 IC 0.113536 (782 dates), 2030-2032 IC 0.209701 (784 dates), and 2033-2035 IC 0.112973 (483 dates). Small 15-asset cross-section requires conservative uncertainty interpretation.
